psychological_meaning: Bitter Lemon evokes a sense of vibrancy and freshness, blending the energy of yellow with the natural calmness of green. It often symbolizes optimism, growth, and a forward-looking perspective, while also hinting at a playful, slightly rebellious attitude. This color is associated with mental clarity and the ability to embrace new beginnings with enthusiasm.
